summary: This video previews high-performing Thunderbolt team builds for Week 3 of the Continental Challenge, based on data from the Chinese servers. It showcases two team configurations centered around Perkunte, Alaura, and Tariz, achieving between 820 million and 950 million damage. The guide details itemization, stat priorities, and skill timing rotations for key heroes like Tariz, Rena, Journ, and Solmo. Additionally, players are advised to hoard summoning resources rather than rushing the current Tariz banner, as an option summons banner and the Child of Chaos event are upcoming.

heroes.name: Tariz
heroes.note: Acts as a support hero focusing on accuracy, skill haste, and attack sharing with Puppeteer set rather than raw DPS.

heroes.name: Perkunte
heroes.note: Delivers massive damage when built with Inspiration 2, high attack, and exclusive artifact.

heroes.name: Alaura
heroes.note: Deals high damage without requiring her exclusive artifact, making her accessible for attack-focused builds.

heroes.name: Rena
heroes.note: Provides strong defense and skill haste with Secrecy set and Inspiration 2 in high-end compositions.

heroes.name: Journ
heroes.note: Diminishes boss rotations using skill haste, accuracy, and support gear.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: Replaces Rena in budget-friendly setups using Secrecy set, high HP, enlightenment, and the Season 8 egg artifact.

teams.note: Achieves around 950 million damage using two top support heroes and standard Thunderbolt skill timings.
Reaches around 820 million damage using Solmo as a accessible support alternative instead of Rena.

meta_changes: Tariz functions as a primary support enabler for high-damage Thunderbolt teams in Continental Challenge Week 3.
tips: Save and hoard summoning dice during the current Tariz banner, as an option summons banner with better rates and the Child of Chaos event are coming soon.
Alaura works effectively without her exclusive artifact, so you do not need to pull or build her specific artifact.
Set ultimate skill timings so that Alaura casts right before Perkunte to maximize damage performance.
